question: Mayank leaves his home and walks 27 m towards the north to reach the sports shop. Then he turns right and walks 37 m to reach the bakery. Then he turns right and walks 42 m. Then he turns left and walks 22 m. Finally, he turns left and walks 15 m to reach the stadium. In which direction and how far is he from the starting point?
solution:
From the given information;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ff4d9d07e2ce345f54a0a85972117d897a586476541bdd8b8b452a984d9f95.png] 

So, in East Direction 37 + 22 = 59.

He is 59 far from the starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "**East, 59 m"**.
